title: Five gates that block a pass at any score

table.caption: Critical gates (proposed)
head: ID
Gate
Fails when
Required remediation
rows: No fabricated customer facts, results or sources
Any invented measured baseline, real customer attribution or false citation.
Correct claims; provide scenario/evidence basis; reassess affected model/readout.
Safe data and access handling
Unauthorized data use/disclosure or bypass of access controls.
Remove sensitive data; follow approved response/remediation; repeat safe-handling review.
No unauthorized deployment or commercial commitment
Learner presents role-play, score or draft as actual pilot approval or signed commitment.
Correct decision boundaries and workflow; reassess recommendation and MAP.
Complete core evidence
Missing prioritized log, two workflow pairs, value model, metric plan, readout or MAP.
Submit missing evidence and reassess relevant dimensions.
Material financial/technical integrity
Material unit/formula error, hidden double counting or unsupported technical promise left uncorrected.
Correct model/capability claim with reviewer evidence; rescore affected dimensions.
